title: Check It arrival parity: pilot walk precheck (FootSlope) and map diagnoses

facts.title: FootSlope: the FootFallback pilot-walk precheck shuts cells steeper than slp 66 (33 deg)
facts.fact: FootPrecheck plans the on-foot walk to a Check It terminal before a bot gets out, but the pilot faces of the No Man's Land mesas (634,74,1227 and 1402,83,774; 39-50 deg faces) were learned only after a failed walk, so the first get-out of each match walked a pilot at an unreachable mesa and cost that side a 'Mech (W_73a b1 out at 24 s, walked 40 s, then went home on foot). The precheck now plans with ma2_path_set_slope_max(66): both mesas give no route (gap 82 / 127 m) while the Killing Fields terminal 2 walk 487,1191 -> 558,1262 (52 m) stays open. Slope 55 broke the Killing Fields walk (gap 76); 78 left the mesa open.
facts.how_to_use: Default on; RECOMP_BOT_FOOT_SLOPE / [Bots] FootSlope; [C7] footslope. Commit 4324819 on v27-parity (exe v13-v27p10).

facts.title: FootPrecheck keeps a failed pilot-walk answer per bot for 10 s
facts.fact: A failed pilot plan to a mesa terminal expands about 300K grid cells (about 40-45 ms on the brain thread, [C7] bots brain_max 42-46 ms in X_73a1/b1), and the FootFallback test re-asks every tick while the bot is blocked: one failure was followed by 138 further asks in X_73a1. foot_walk_ok now stores the no-walk verdict per bot index and reuses it for 10 s while the terminal (within 1 m) and the bot (within 10 m) are unchanged; a new match (time going back) drops it.
facts.how_to_use: [C7] footprecheck no_walk= / cached= (X_73a1: no_walk 3, cached 415). Part of FootPrecheck, no separate switch.

facts.title: FootBodySkip: a terminal FootPrecheck found unwalkable is skipped while the bot stays in that hull
facts.fact: With FootSlope a 'Mech no longer gets out at the No Man's Land mesas, but ObjGiveUp's 25 s skip ran out and the same 'Mech drove back to the mesa foot again (X_73a2 b1 at 36.7 / 74.6 / 129.7 s and b3 at 27.1 / 103.0 s from 556-563,1142-1148; X_73b2 b6 four times at 1402,774), so team 1 had one ground arrival in X_73a2. obj_checkit now skips the terminal whose pilot walk failed while the bot is in the same hull (Ma2Brain.nowalk_actor / nowalk_ent, set by foot_walk_ok); a new body (BattleArmor, pilot, other 'Mech) may try it again.
facts.how_to_use: Default on; RECOMP_BOT_FOOT_BODY_SKIP / [Bots] FootBodySkip; [C7] footbodyskip skipped=. Commit 4324819 on v27-parity, exe v13-v27p10; live Y_73a1: each bot asks once, footbodyskip skipped=1211, no_walk 3, cached 4.

facts.title: Check It map 4: team 2 spawns 260-300 m further from every terminal (map-made arrival gap)
facts.fact: Check It map 4 (mode 7 map 4) terminals 1431,767 / 1267,1072 / 1073,976 / 856,1224 / 489,1017. Team 1 spawns around 1676,868, team 2 around 333,1513: nearest terminal 263 m vs 521 m, middle terminal 1073,976 612 m vs 915 m. First ground arrivals at any terminal 22-26 s vs 38-39 s (W_74a/b) follow the distance; no bot stall was found (no FootPrecheck, no not-10-m-closer give-ups). The gap is made by the map, not by the bots.

facts.title: Check It map 1: team 2 nearest terminal is 84 m further; middle-terminal gap from fights and the pit terminal
facts.fact: Check It map 1 (mode 7 map 1) terminals 1073,628 / 1004,-20,1025 (in a pit) / 796,1161 / 662,1711 / 379,1371. Team 1 spawns near 311,958, team 2 near 1222,1475: nearest terminal 418 m vs 500 m, so a first-arrival gap of about 5-10 s is map-made. The middle terminal 796,1161 is equidistant (525 / 529 m) but team 2 reached it at 89-123 s vs 44-66 s: team 2 bodies stall 100-200 m out fighting team 1 who already hold it, and W_71a b8 spent 46-76 s at 1082,951 above the pit terminal (y 17-28 vs -20) before ObjGiveUp's not-10-m-closer skip. Defenders of both sides hunt 20-60 s before their first objective (symmetric; the gap depends on how many defenders a side draws).
